For someone who likes quality but isn’t fussy and will actually use the gift, a Chilly’s Series 2 or Series 3 water bottle is a solid bet:

High‑quality, BPA‑free stainless steel with antimicrobial drinking surfaces
Serious insulation to keep drinks cold or hot for hours
100% leak‑proof when properly closed, great for daily on‑the‑go use

If they’re more into coffee, a Series 2 or New Original Coffee Cup gives similar insulation and portable, mostly leak‑proof or leak‑proof performance with simple, hand‑wash care.

So, go for a water bottle (Series 2/3) for all‑round everyday use, or a Coffee Cup if they’re a regular hot‑drink person.
